note: forkPointSha is the upstream commit (v0.3.26) this fork started tracking from; it never moves. lastReviewedSha is the last upstream commit a decision log classified; only .claude/skills/upstream-review/scripts/upstream-review.sh --advance <sha> moves it, and only forward. The review window runs from lastReviewedSha to the newest upstream v* tag past it, or to upstream/main when no tag is newer (--tip forces the tip). The merge-base is computed, not stored.
